description: This file defines a custom Android View component called SlidingTabStrip, which is used for rendering sliding tabs with indicators, dividers, and custom colorization. It manages drawing an indicator, underlines, and dividers for tab views within a layout.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout subclass that handles drawing the visual indicators and dividers for a sliding tab layout, including color customization and drawing logic based on the current selected tab.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface defining methods for providing indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: A simple implementation of TabColorizer that uses arrays of colors to color indicators and dividers.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for coloring the tab indicators and dividers.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the indicator under the selected tab.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the dividers between tabs.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected position and offset when the page changes, triggering a redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw to render the indicator, underline, and dividers based on the current state.

methods.name: setColorAlpha
methods.description: Utility method to set the alpha component of a color.

methods.name: blendColors
methods.description: Utility method to blend two colors based on a ratio.
